Maya (sales): Heads-up — AcmeCorp wants an enterprise POC capacity plan and a rough pricing handshake. They expect chat traffic: baseline ~200 RPS, spikes to ~800 RPS for 30–90s every ~10 minutes. 95th latency target ~300ms. They asked about reserved GPUs + burst/autoscale strategy. Any immediate red flags?
Sam (eng-runtime): Can we get token-per-request distribution? burst concurrency?
Maya (sales): Typical message ~60 tokens, 10% of calls up to ~400 tokens. Concurrency during spike ~1200 concurrent requests.
Ravi (infra): No red flags. Recommend reserved pool sized for sustained load (200 RPS) + autoscale for short spikes. Suggest preheat slots to avoid cold-start queues.
Sam (eng-runtime): Quick capacity sketch — rough numbers only. Using model+quantized baseline we expect ~6000 tokens/sec per GPU (optimistic 13B quantized path).
Sam (eng-runtime): ```
peak_tokens_per_sec = 800 * 60 = 48000
gpus_needed_peak = ceil(48000 / 6000) = 8 GPUs
sustained_tokens_per_sec = 200 * 60 = 12000
gpus_sustained = ceil(12000 / 6000) = 2 GPUs
```
Sam (eng-runtime): So plan: reserve 3 GPUs (cover sustained + 1 buffer), autoscale up to 9 GPUs for safety during spikes, with burst-credit allowance for short 90s windows.
Jess (solutions): Add KV/prefix cache notes — for chat-heavy workloads cache hit-rate reduces token work a lot. If we can warm prefixes for the top 5 templates, effective GPU need could drop by ~25-40% during spikes. Recommend prewarming 4 slots for top flows.
Ravi (infra): Autoscale policy proposal: scale-up when queue > 50% for 8s, scale step +2 GPUs, max burst to 3x reserved (configurable), cooldown 180s. Preheat: spawn warm workers ~60s before expected windows if schedule known.
Liam (legal): Security & contracts: Acme asked about KMS, audit logs, and data residency. Private deployment (VPC) + dedicated reserved pool preferred for enterprise SLA. This will affect pricing and lead time.
Maya (sales): Pricing Q: how do we charge burst? flat per-GPU-hour or credit model?
Ravi (infra): We support both — recommended: reserved monthly SKU + burst hourly at a premium (or consume prepaid burst credits). We can model cost both ways for finance.
Sam (eng-runtime): Ops note: implement graceful fallback policy to smaller cheaper model if capacity exhausted (route 10% traffic to fallback). Keeps latency and availability SLA.
preheat-bot: Preheat job scheduled: 4 slots for acme-poc at 2026-04-15T09:00Z (:rocket:).
Maya (sales): Thanks — can eng + finance finalize numbers in a spreadsheet? If we can get a signed plan + pricing by EOD Wednesday they want kickoff next week.
Sam (eng-runtime): I'll drop a calc sheet and link it here by EOD. Ravi and Jess — can you sanity-check the autoscale params?
Ravi (infra): On it, will add AZ spread + eviction hedge notes.
Jess (solutions): Will add cache heatmap and suggested prewarm list.
Liam (legal): I'll prepare a short note on KMS and timeline for Private deployment.
Maya (sales): Great, thanks everyone :pray:
